name: transformationMatrix
description: Returns the upstream local transformation matrix, or null if there isn't one.

name: globalTransformationMatrix
description: Returns the upstream global transformation matrix, or null if there isn't one.

name: index
description: The index of the object (in, for example, a Duplicator).

name: count
description: The number of shapes being calculated (in, for example, a Duplicator).

name: attributeId
description: The id of the Attribute being calculated.

name: layerId
description: The layer id being calculated.

name: niceName
description: The nice name of the layer being calculated.

name: hasObject
description: Checks if an object with the specified name exists and can be loaded.

name: saveObject
description: Saves an object which can then be retreived on future calculations.

name: loadObject
description: Loads an object which has been previously saved.

name: getBoundingBox
description: Returns an object representing the bounding box of the shape being deformed.

name: getFalloffAtPoint
description: Returns the falloff value (0-1) at the given local position, multiplied by strength.

name: meshDepth
description: The maximum mesh depth.

name: meshCountAtDepth
description: Returns the mesh count at the given depth.

name: highestDepthWithPath
description: Returns the highest depth with a path

name: getMeshesAtDepth
description: Returns an array of Mesh objects.

name: setMeshesAtDepth
description: Sets an array of meshes at the given depth.

name: getMeshAtDepthAtIndex
description: Returns a Mesh at the given depth and index.

name: setMeshAtDepthAtIndex
description: Replaces a mesh at a specific depth and index with the provided mesh object.

name: setTransformAtDepthAtIndex
description: Applies a transformation to a mesh at a specific depth and index.

name: clearTransformAtDepthAtIndex
description: Clears the transform of a mesh at a specific depth and index.

name: centrePivotAtDepthAtIndex
description: Centers the pivot of a mesh at a specific depth and index.

name: setMaterialAtDepthAtIndex
description: Sets the material of a mesh at a specific depth and index.

name: getPoints
description: Retrieves an array of point objects from all meshes.

name: setPoints
description: Sets the positions of points in all meshes using an array of point objects.

name: getRootMesh
description: Returns the root Mesh with its full hierarchy of child meshes for recursive traversal.

name: setRootMesh
description: Sets the root Mesh, replacing the entire mesh hierarchy.

methods.name: appendPoint
methods.description: Append a Point to the cloud.

methods.name: appendRotation
methods.description: Append a rotation in degrees to the cloud. Make sure there's a corresponding point.

methods.name: appendSize
methods.description: Append a size to the cloud. Make sure there's a corresponding point.

properties.name: length
properties.description: Gets the total length of the path.

properties.name: isClosed
properties.description: Indicates whether the path is closed.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the starting point of a new contour to the (x, y) coordinates.

methods.name: lineTo
methods.description: Adds a straight line.

methods.name: cubicTo
methods.description: Adds a cubic Bézier curve to the path.

methods.name: quadTo
methods.description: Adds a quadratic Bézier curve to the path.

methods.name: arcTo
methods.description: Adds an arc to the path which is tangential to the line from the current point to (x1, y1), ending at (x2, y2).

methods.name: conicTo
methods.description: Adds a conic to the path weighted by w.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the current contour by drawing a straight line back to the start.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the entire path, removing all points.

methods.name: addRect
methods.description: Adds a rectangle to the path.

methods.name: addEllipse
methods.description: Adds an ellipse to the path.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds the text string to the path at the specified location and font size.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Applies a translation to the path.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates the path by the specified radians.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales the path by the given x and y factors.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends another Path object to this path.

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Sets this path to the intersection of it and another path.

methods.name: unite
methods.description: Combines this path with another path.

methods.name: difference
methods.description: Subtracts another path from this path.

methods.name: convertToCurves
methods.description: Converts all lines in the path to Bézier curves.

methods.name: mergeOverlaps
methods.description: Converts the path into a set of non-overlapping contours that describe the same area as the original path.

methods.name: convertToLines
methods.description: Converts all Bézier curves in the path to straight lines.

methods.name: toObject
methods.description: Returns a serialized object representing the path.

methods.name: fromObject
methods.description: Deserializes and sets the path from an object.

methods.name: boundingBox
methods.description: Calculates and returns the bounding box of the path.

methods.name: findClosestPoint
methods.description: Finds the closest point on the path to the given (x, y) coordinates.

methods.name: tangentAtParam
methods.description: Calculates the tangent vector at the given parameter t along the path.

methods.name: normalAtParam
methods.description: Calculates the normal vector at the given parameter t along the path.

methods.name: angleAtParam
methods.description: Calculates the angle of the tangent at the given parameter t along the path.

methods.name: paramAtLength
methods.description: Finds the parameter along the path corresponding to the given length.

methods.name: pointAtParam
methods.description: Calculates the point at the given parameter t along the path.

methods.name: pointCount
methods.description: Returns the number of points in the path.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Determines whether the path contains the given (x, y) point.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the path is empty.

methods.name: pathData
methods.description: Retrieves the path data representing the path.

methods.name: setPathData
methods.description: Sets the path based on the provided path data.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims the path according to the specified parameters.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Offsets the path by a certain distance, optionally with rounded joins.

methods.name: resample
methods.description: Rebuilds the path by sampling points based on a desired 'edgeLength'.

methods.name: additiveResample
methods.description: Adds points to the current path based on a desired 'edgeLength'.

methods.name: lineIntersections
methods.description: Returns an array of points at which the path and line intersect.

methods.name: pathIntersections
methods.description: Returns an array of points at which this path and the given path intersect.

methods.name: relax
methods.description: Relax the points in the path away from each other.

methods.name: smooth
methods.description: Smooths the points by averaging their positions.

methods.name: applyMatrix
methods.description: Multiply the path point positions by a matrix.

methods.name: scatter
methods.description: Scatter points inside the path via dart throwing. Points are relaxed by default.

methods.name: convertConicsToQuads
methods.description: Converts any conic verbs to quad verbs, this might be useful as not all features in Cavalry support conic verbs.

methods.name: fastArea
methods.description: Returns the area of the path in square pixels. This method does not support holes.

methods.name: isClockwise
methods.description: Returns true if the path is clockwise.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses the Path direction.

properties.name: strokeColor
properties.description: The color of the stroke as a hex string.

properties.name: fillColor
properties.description: The color of the fill as a hex string.

properties.name: fill
properties.description: Indicates whether the material should be filled.

properties.name: stroke
properties.description: Indicates whether the material should have a stroke.

properties.name: trim
properties.description: Indicates whether the stroke should be trimmed.

properties.name: trimReversed
properties.description: Indicates whether the trim should be applied in reverse.

properties.name: trimStart
properties.description: The start position of the trim.

properties.name: trimEnd
properties.description: The end position of the trim.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a path to the mesh. If no material is provided, the path inherits the material from its parent mesh.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of paths in the mesh.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the mesh is empty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all paths from the mesh.

methods.name: getPathDataAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the path data at the specified index. Usful for exiting existing points.

methods.name: getPathAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the Path object at the specified index. Useful for adding to a path.

methods.name: setPathAtIndex
methods.description: Sets the path at the specified index.

methods.name: setPathDataAtIndex
methods.description: Sets the path data at the specified index.

methods.name: setMaterialAtIndex
methods.description: Sets the material for the path at the specified index. Pass null to clear the material and inherit from parent.

methods.name: getBoundingBox
methods.description: Calculates and returns the bounding box of the entire mesh.

methods.name: addChildMesh
methods.description: Adds a child mesh to this Mesh.

methods.name: clearChildMeshes
methods.description: Deletes all the child Meshes on this Mesh.

methods.name: childMeshCount
methods.description: Returns the number of child Meshes.

methods.name: getChildMeshAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the child Mesh at the given index.

methods.name: setChildMeshAtIndex
methods.description: Sets the child Mesh at the given index.

methods.name: getFlattenedPath
methods.description: Returns a path representing the combined geometry of this mesh and all child meshes.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Gets the length of the line.

methods.name: angle
methods.description: Gets the angle of the line in radians.

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the line.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets the angle of the line in radians.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Retrieves the start point of the line.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Retrieves the end point of the line.

methods.name: delta
methods.description: Calculates the delta (difference in coordinates) between the start and end points of the line.

methods.name: pointAt
methods.description: Calculates the point at a given parameter t along the line.

methods.name: normalAt
methods.description: Calculates the normal vector at a given parameter t along the line.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates the line by a given point vector.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculates the shortest distance from the line to a given point.

methods.name: closestPointTo
methods.description: Calculates the closest point on the line to a given point.

methods.name: lineIntersection
methods.description: Returns the point at which two lines intersect, or null if there's no intersection.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the position (translation) of the matrix.

methods.name: setRotation
methods.description: Sets the rotation of the matrix in degrees.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Sets the scale factors of the matrix.

methods.name: setSkew
methods.description: Sets the skew factors of the matrix.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Gets the scale factors of the matrix.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Gets the position (translation) of the matrix.

methods.name: skew
methods.description: Gets the skew of the matrix.

methods.name: rotation
methods.description: Gets the rotation of the matrix in degrees.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Returns a new matrix that is the result of multiplying this matrix with another matrix.

methods.name: inverted
methods.description: Returns a new matrix that is the inverse of this matrix.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Inverts this matrix in place.

methods.name: isFinite
methods.description: Checks if all elements of the matrix are finite.

methods.name: isIdentity
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is an identity matrix.

methods.name: mapRect
methods.description: Maps a rectangle {x,y,width,height} using this matrix and returns the resulting rectangle.

methods.name: mapPoint
methods.description: Maps a point using this matrix and returns the resulting point.

methods.name: mapPoints
methods.description: Maps an array of points using this matrix and returns the resulting array of points.

name: random
description: Create a random number.

name: uniform
description: Create a uniformly distributed random number.

name: noise1d
description: Sample 1d Simplex Noise at the given X coodrinate.

name: noise2d
description: Sample 2d Simplex Noise at the given XY coodrinate.

name: noise3d
description: Sample 3d Simplex Noise at the given XYZ coodrinate.

name: dist
description: Calculates the distance between two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).

name: map
description: Re-maps a number from one range to another.

name: norm
description: Normalizes a number within a range.

name: clamp
description: Clamps a value between a minimum and a maximum number.

name: lerp
description: Performs linear interpolation between values min and max.

name: degreesToRadians
description: Converts an angle in degrees to radians.

name: radiansToDegrees
description: Converts an angle in radians to degrees.

name: angleFromVector
description: Calculates the angle (in radians) from a vector (x, y).

name: vectorFromAngle
description: Creates a vector from an angle in radians.

name: hexToHsv
description: Converts a hex color value to its HSV representation.

name: hexToRgba
description: Converts a hex color value to its RGBA representation, optionally scaled to the range of 0-1.

name: rgbToHsv
description: Converts RGB color values to their HSV representation.

name: rgbToHex
description: Converts RGB color values to their hex color string representation.

name: rgbaToHex
description: Converts RGBA color values to their hex color string representation.

name: hsvToHex
description: Converts HSV color values to their hex color string representation.

name: hsvToRgba
description: Converts HSV color values to their RGBA representation.

name: nameThatColor
description: Returns a W3C color name that's the closest match to the specified hex color.

name: versionLessThan
description: Compares the given version string with the Cavalry version.

name: fontExists
description: Checks if a font with the given family and style exists.

name: getFontFamilies
description: Retrieves a list of available font families.

name: getFontStyles
description: Retrieves a list of available styles for a given font family.

name: measureText
description: Measures the dimensions of the given text with specified font settings.
